title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX
summary: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX is KONAMI's card game for Switch 2, with a release date of February 16, 2027 and a price of $49.99. The 8.8 GB size comes from the pre-release listing and may change. It is a small install, so storage will not be a concern. The physical version is a Game-Key Card, so you still need to download the game after inserting the cartridge. Multiplayer is one of its strengths: the eShop lists up to 8 players over local wireless and up to 32 online, which suits tournaments and duels with friends. Performance figures have not been published yet.
